differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 41.9 fL) with low hemoglobin and risk factors (poor diet, chronic inflammation) makes iron deficiency most likely.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic sinusitis and ongoing inflammatory stress can suppress iron utilization, producing a mild microcytic anemia.

differential.name: Beta thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Persistent microcytosis with relatively normal iron studies (not provided) is classic for thalassemia minor in adults.

differential.name: Anemia secondary to chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Reduced eGFR (≈80 mL/min) and elevated creatinine suggest early CKD, which can cause decreased erythropoietin production.

differential.name: Folate deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Low‑grade anemia in a patient with poor nutrition and chronic stress; folate deficiency can present with borderline microcytosis before macrocytosis develops.
